text: Policy SEC-204: Employees must use multi-factor authentication when signing in to company systems.
Policy TRV-118: A meal expense is reimbursable up to $45 per day while traveling.
Policy PTO-031: Employees receive 18 paid vacation days each calendar year.
Policy RET-550: The company matches 4% of eligible employee retirement contributions.
Policy NAM-009: The data-protection contact is Maya Chen, Director of Privacy.
Policy INC-772: Report a suspected security incident within 24 hours using the incident portal.
To keep accounts safe, prove your identity with a second factor in addition to your password before accessing work tools.
When staff are away on business, the organization covers reasonable food costs, subject to the daily allowance.
Team members can take paid time away from work for rest and personal plans; unused leave follows the annual leave rules.
For retirement savings, the employer adds money in proportion to qualifying amounts workers put into their plan.
Questions about personal information and privacy should go to the person responsible for protecting customer data.
If you think company information or systems may have been compromised, notify the response team promptly through the reporting channel.
The office closes on listed public holidays; managers publish the yearly calendar in January.
New employees complete workplace safety orientation during their first week.
Customer records must be retained according to the schedule maintained by Legal and Compliance.
Reimbursement claims require a receipt and manager approval before Finance processes payment.
Policy WFH-206: Employees may work from home up to 3 days per week with manager approval; some roles may require more on-site time.
Policy HR-322: Employees must provide 30 calendar days of written notice before resigning from the company.
Policy LEAVE-104: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year and should notify their manager before the start of a missed shift.
Policy PARENT-208: The primary caregiver may take 16 weeks of paid parental leave after a birth or adoption.
